basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 28-year-old mechanical keyboard enthusiast from Ann Arbor, Michigan. I work as a software developer, which naturally led me to explore the fascinating world of custom keyboards. When I'm not coding or tinkering with my keyboard setups, I enjoy playing around with emulation on my LG G8X, keeping up with the latest Bethesda releases, and building complex nanoblock structures. My evenings are typically spent online, and I often browse Reddit to unwind after a day of work. I'm married to a fellow tech aficionado, and we share our home with a lively Labrador. I prefer to keep my online interactions straightforward and informative.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having graduated with a degree from the University of Michigan. My interest in technology extends beyond my job, as I am self-taught in emulation and have a keen interest in mechanical keyboards, particularly the Ergodox EZ. I often contribute to discussions about custom keyboard builds and tech troubleshooting in related subreddits.
